title: Whisky in Hot Countries
subtitle: Single malt from India and Taiwan
description: How Amrut, Paul John and Kavalan began making single malt in India and Taiwan, and why heat keeps the age off their labels. Four pours.

pours.name: Amrut Fusion
pours.notes: Neat first, then a few drops of water. Notice how early the oak comes through.

pours.name: Paul John Brilliance
pours.notes: Indian six-row barley and ex-bourbon casks, with no peat. Taste it beside the Amrut.

pours.name: Kavalan Classic
pours.notes: The distillery’s first single malt, released in 2008. Look at the colour from a distillery that began in 2006.

pours.name: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old
pours.notes: The control: twelve years in Speyside at about 2% a year. Compare it with the Kavalan.
